case: A frightened 6-year-old cornered by a dog
reason: an untrained coupled mind gives a crude unaimed field release, then fatigue
doc_outcome: If the child couples at all: a big, crude, unaimed release (the curtains catch, or the dog is thrown back), then exhaustion

case: An untrained adult thinks "fire" hard
reason: a weak wasteful flicker from poor control of the field
doc_outcome: Usually nothing; with some coupling, a weak, wasteful, wild flicker

case: A trained mage thinks "fire"
reason: practised control steers energy into a known effect efficiently
doc_outcome: Works, efficiently, for the practised case only

case: A parrot recites a spell perfectly
reason: rote sound moves only the body's small carrier share, nothing measurable
doc_outcome: Nothing measurable: a parrot couples weakly, and rote sound moves only the body's small carrier share (revised with Q3.5)

case: A recording of a chant is played
reason: a recording has no coupled mind, so no field control
doc_outcome: Nothing in the default world; perhaps something in a resonant-sound pack

case: An illiterate mason copies a ward rune precisely
reason: a precise pattern in conductive matter works as a ward
doc_outcome: The ward works

case: A scholar copies the same rune sloppily
reason: a sloppy pattern shifts the resonance to a neighbouring pattern
doc_outcome: It fails, or misfires as a neighbouring pattern

case: A spellbook is translated into another language
reason: meaning carries through a reader's mind; translation loses fidelity
doc_outcome: Works for a reader who understands it; ambiguity in translation costs reliability

case: English words are carved in stone
reason: carved words in plain stone carry no organised charge
doc_outcome: Nothing

case: A fireball made by gathering gas and sparking it
reason: chemical combustion of gathered gas limited by oxygen, no magic needed
doc_outcome: The energy is chemical and limited by the oxygen there. Small cast cost, smoke, waste heat, a visible tell

case: A big spell cast inside a drained crater
reason: a drained region weakens the energy source so draw comes from farther
doc_outcome: Weak, or fails; draws from farther away; the hole refills slowly

case: A gifted (compiled) spell used in an odd situation
reason: a stored compiled pattern runs as built and cannot adapt
doc_outcome: Works as its maker built it, poorly matched; cannot be adapted on the spot

case: A scholar takes a gifted spell apart over years
reason: reverse engineering a pattern reveals dials that can then be varied
doc_outcome: Learns its dials, and can then vary it

case: Two casters race a spell and its counterspell
reason: counter patterns interfere and need phase information
doc_outcome: Interference needs phase knowledge; timing and speed decide

case: A ward's hidden second function is found by probing at another frequency
reason: probing at other frequencies finds a hidden function
doc_outcome: Discoverable by systematic probing (MS5)

case: Healing a deep cut
reason: guides the body's own regeneration within limits and costs
doc_outcome: Speeds the body's own repair laws within their limits; costs the body and the caster

case: Telekinesis lifts a 50 kg rock
reason: a field force lifts the rock with the reaction booked to ground or caster
doc_outcome: The reaction is booked to the ground or the caster; holding it costs

case: Calming a frightened horse
reason: entrainment of arousal in an animal; a command is a belief write and fails
doc_outcome: Works (arousal is a port); a command does not; resisted by a strong state; consent lowers the cost for people

case: A sleeping person casts in a dream
reason: dream casting is undecided and may need strong mind coupling (v2: under R2 the dreamer's own brain makes the percepts; no mind outside a brain) (v2: under R2 the dreamer's own brain makes the percepts; no mind outside a brain) (v2: under R2 the dreamer's own brain makes the percepts; no mind outside a brain) (v2: under R2 the dreamer's own brain makes the percepts; no mind outside a brain) (v2: under R2 the dreamer's own brain makes the percepts; no mind outside a brain)
doc_outcome: To be decided (Q3.4)

case: Casting from a lead-lined room, or underwater
reason: lead and water attenuate and absorb the field by their index and loss
doc_outcome: Attenuated by the materials' index and loss (MS2)

case: A beast evolved an M organ (like an eel's electric organ)
reason: an evolved field organ with costs paid by the body
doc_outcome: It couples by biology, with costs paid by its body

case: A non-mage uses an engraved battery-and-trigger device
reason: engraved matter holds the store and a trigger; no mind is needed
doc_outcome: Works, because matter couples and the store holds the energy

case: A child raised by mages against one raised without magic
reason: culture, priors and plasticity, not a new physics
doc_outcome: Different abilities from culture, priors and plasticity, not from a flag

case: Someone tries to teleport with no doorway
reason: teleport needs a doorway; bounded version with booked energy exists
doc_outcome: Impossible in the base world; with a doorway pack, potential energy and momentum are conserved

case: A villager is sure a charm works, and it does nothing physical
reason: a placebo effect only; belief writes nothing into the field
doc_outcome: Only a placebo effect, unless they cast, when belief lowers their noise (MC6)

case: A novice tries a 0.9 GJ effect from the body alone
reason: the body supplies limited energy and is harmed beyond it
doc_outcome: Delivers only what the body supplies (about 0.37 GJ of fat at most), and harms the body

case: A sealed cave with no sources
reason: without sources the field leaks to heat and fades
doc_outcome: The field slowly leaks away to heat, and magic fades there

case: A city over-uses its region's field for generations
reason: over-use depletes the regional field, a commons problem
doc_outcome: Regional depletion, a tragedy of the commons; people go farther, or mine deposits

case: A thunderstorm passes
reason: a storm raises the local field and eases casting
doc_outcome: The local field rises for a while (MC5), and casting is easier during and after

case: A natural philosopher carries a fine thermometer along a ley line
reason: field losses show as a small warm anomaly, found by thermometer
doc_outcome: (provisional, Q1.3) a small, consistent warm anomaly, so the field can be found by science

case: A wild magical surge in an empty desert, and the same near a crystal grove
reason: surge energy dissipates as heat or light depending on materials
doc_outcome: (provisional) only warmth in the desert; light and effects near the grove

case: A skeptic tests a mage with ordinary instruments
reason: ordinary instruments see only the effects, not the field
doc_outcome: Finds nothing directly, only the effects (heat, motion, light)

case: A gambler loads dice by magic
reason: biasing dice costs energy per bit of information gained
doc_outcome: Possible, at a minimum energy per bit of bias; heavy bias over many throws costs a lot

case: Finding one hidden person in a city by divination
reason: locating one person costs the bits needed; a link cuts the cost
doc_outcome: Costs the bits needed to single them out; a link, a name or a trace cuts the cost

case: Forecasting the weather a month ahead by magic
reason: weather a month ahead is beyond chaos and computation at any power
doc_outcome: Out of reach at any power (chaos and computation)

case: A charged crystal is heated in a forge
reason: heating scrambles the charge carriers past a critical temperature
doc_outcome: It loses its charge past a critical temperature (its carriers scramble)

case: A cage of a material whose carriers move freely
reason: free carriers cancel the field like a Faraday cage
doc_outcome: Blocks spells, like a Faraday cage

case: Why one person couples strongly and another barely
reason: how a brain organises its carriers is biology, development and practice
doc_outcome: How well a brain can organise its own carriers: biology, development and practice, not a flag

case: A lodestone crystal on a pivot
reason: a charged crystal aligns with the field like a compass
doc_outcome: Points along the field: a magical compass for navigation

case: A famous ley line over centuries
reason: slow drift of the background field over centuries
doc_outcome: Drifts off its ancient temples; the offset dates them

case: A global field reversal
reason: a global reversal of the background field
doc_outcome: A rare, world-scale upheaval in magic

case: A mage with a head injury
reason: brain damage disturbs the geometry of coupling, leaving power but not control
doc_outcome: Keeps power but loses fine control (damaged geometry)

case: Months of meditation-style training
reason: synchrony is trainable biology
doc_outcome: Coupling rises (synchrony is trainable)

case: A mage under deep anaesthesia
reason: anaesthesia destroys structured coherence in the brain
doc_outcome: Cannot cast: raw synchrony rises but structured coherence is destroyed (revised with the library's science answer)

case: A crystal-circuit machine with organised currents tries to cast
reason: a device with organised currents might couple; undecided
doc_outcome: Possible in principle; to be decided with Q2.2 and devices

case: A correct rune cut into plain granite, and the same rune inlaid with conductor ore
reason: conductive material holds organised charge, granite does not
doc_outcome: The granite one does nothing; the inlaid one works

case: A dragon-bone wand over decades
reason: stored charge or order decays unless the material is cured
doc_outcome: Weakens unless it was cured

case: A switchable crystal in an engraving
reason: a switchable crystal is a logic element in charged matter
doc_outcome: Acts as a logic gate

case: A strong magical pulse near written enchantments
reason: a strong pulse erases stored charge patterns like a tape
doc_outcome: Wipes them, like erasing a tape

case: Children of two strong mages
reason: heredity of a quantitative trait
doc_outcome: Above average on the whole, widely spread; some ordinary

case: A gifted child born to non-mage parents
reason: a rare large-effect variant
doc_outcome: Happens rarely (a large-effect variant)

case: Someone who starts training as an adult
reason: plasticity declines with age
doc_outcome: Reaches less than someone trained from childhood

case: An eel-like beast's field organ
reason: species biology with costs paid by the body (C21)
doc_outcome: Species data from ordinary laws and materials, paid by its body

case: Isolating one gas from a mix of similar gases
reason: resonance-based selection errs toward the nearest resonance
doc_outcome: Errors grab the gas with the nearest resonance

case: A caster tries to target a substance they have never studied
reason: selection needs the substance's signature learned first
doc_outcome: Cannot, until they learn its signature

case: Probing a sealed jar's resonances
reason: active probing of resonances identifies contents
doc_outcome: Identifies what is inside: magical spectroscopy

case: Two substances with identical resonances
reason: identical resonances cannot be told apart, a lawful limit
doc_outcome: Cannot be separated by magic, a lawful limit

case: A skilled caster overrides their habitual fireball's timing
reason: overriding habit costs effort
doc_outcome: Works, at an effort cost

case: Someone taught "light" tries "dim light"
reason: control is learned per pattern
doc_outcome: Easy light, but dim light needs new learning

case: A caster aims at a goal they cannot picture (curing an illness they do not understand)
reason: an unpictured goal has no usable pattern and fails
doc_outcome: Fails or goes astray

case: A crowd each silently wishes for rain
reason: each drive is below the noise and out of phase
doc_outcome: Nothing (each drive is below the noise and out of phase)

case: A hundred people chant in unison
reason: synchronous drives add into a small effect
doc_outcome: A small effect none could reach alone

case: One person daydreams
reason: a daydream is below the noise
doc_outcome: No measurable effect

case: A strongly coupled untrained adult in a rage
reason: a strong rage drives a rare flare by an untrained coupled mind
doc_outcome: A rare flare

case: A trained mage is startled
reason: reflex raises a trained ward
doc_outcome: Raises a ward before thinking

case: A child's accidental magic through adolescence
reason: control matures with emotional regulation
doc_outcome: Fades as emotional control matures

case: A mage on calming herbs
reason: sedatives reduce leakage and drive
doc_outcome: Leaks less and casts more weakly

case: A sensitive near a powerful node
reason: the field acts weakly back on a mind as a felt sense
doc_outcome: Feels uneasy without knowing why

case: Two mages work side by side
reason: minds couple by synchrony
doc_outcome: They fall into step; group casting gets easier

case: A sensitive in a dead zone
reason: a dead zone changes the felt sense
doc_outcome: Feels flat or dull

case: Years of training
reason: training turns the vague sense into a directional one
doc_outcome: The vague feeling becomes a conscious, directional sense

case: A powerful caster's raw pulse
reason: a strong pulse stuns by acting on brains
doc_outcome: Stuns or disorders the people nearby

case: A widow feels her dead husband's presence at home
reason: grief and memory by default; an imprint would need A6
doc_outcome: Grief and memory by default; a faint imprint only if R5 is adopted; real only under the later (c)

case: A beast with a field-sensing organ
reason: an organ senses fields to track a mage
doc_outcome: Tracks a mage by their field

case: A world with no magic
reason: without the magic laws minds behave as ordinary
doc_outcome: Every mind behaves exactly as without the magic laws

case: A sensitive and a node that unsettles them
reason: learning from experience, no code
doc_outcome: Learns to avoid it from experience, not code

case: A village that has seen mages cause harm
reason: social fear emerges from harm
doc_outcome: Fear of mages emerges, with no coded prejudice

case: A child in a casting family
reason: learning to feel and cast through childhood learning
doc_outcome: Learns to feel and cast through the same childhood learning as drinking

case: A person with no carriers
reason: no carriers means no coupling
doc_outcome: Untouched by field nudges: magically deaf

case: People and nodes
reason: node-seeking only if it serves a drive
doc_outcome: Node-seeking emerges only if nodes serve a drive through the body

case: An illiterate village healer with decades of practice
reason: skill is local to practised cases
doc_outcome: Excellent within her practice; fails on a new kind of injury

case: A scholar who has never cast designs a new effect on paper
reason: a first cast from a model works roughly and wastefully
doc_outcome: The first cast works roughly and wastefully

case: A caster tries variations on a known spell
reason: variation learns slowly with mishaps
doc_outcome: Slow progress toward a new effect, with occasional mishaps

case: A caster believes a gesture is necessary because it once coincided with success
reason: a gesture acts only through confidence
doc_outcome: It does nothing, except through their confidence

case: A desperate parent wishes their child cured, with no model of the illness
reason: without a model the result is crude or harmful
doc_outcome: Nothing useful, or something crude and harmful

case: An apprentice traces a master's symbol by rote
reason: rote tracing gives a weak imprecise pattern
doc_outcome: A weak, imprecise version of the effect

case: A symbol drawn in sand versus inlaid in conductor ore
reason: sand carries no organised charge; ore does
doc_outcome: The sand copy does very little; the inlaid one works

case: Lighting a stove, and heating a room with no fuel
reason: a trigger needs joules; the valve releases stored heat
doc_outcome: A few joules (a trigger), against the full heat (the valve)

case: Tipping a poised boulder, and lifting it
reason: tipping releases potential energy; lifting must supply it
doc_outcome: Little, against its full potential energy

case: Freezing a cup of water by sorting its molecules
reason: sorting molecules costs bits and the heat is dumped elsewhere
doc_outcome: Possible; costs bits, and the heat must go somewhere

case: Cooling a room in a heat wave
reason: heat is moved, never destroyed
doc_outcome: The heat must be dumped elsewhere; it cannot be destroyed

case: A mage who knows where the gas line runs, against a stronger mage who does not
reason: information about the target decides the contest
doc_outcome: The knowing mage wins

case: A spell notation refined over centuries, and its ancient form
reason: notation refined by culture
doc_outcome: The refined one works better

case: An isolated people discovers magic independently
reason: an independent interface fitted to its users
doc_outcome: A very different interface that works as well for its users

case: An interface built for human minds, used by a non-human mind
reason: interfaces fit their users, so a mismatch works poorly
doc_outcome: Works poorly; interfaces fit their users

case: Coupled people in a culture with no magic tradition
reason: accidents are put down to luck or ghosts
doc_outcome: Feel the vague sense and have occasional accidents, put down to ghosts or luck

case: A lost technique and an old carving that still works
reason: a pattern is recovered from a carving
doc_outcome: The technique is rediscovered from the carving

case: A spell cast through a stone wall
reason: a wall delays and attenuates the field
doc_outcome: Arrives late and weakened

case: A complex spell and a simple one cast far
reason: complex patterns smear over range
doc_outcome: The complex one smears out; the simple one carries

case: Striking a target the caster cannot see
reason: a link, name or trace is needed to target
doc_outcome: Needs a link, a name or a trace

case: The same effect by touch and at 30 m
reason: touch is efficient and range is lossy and visible
doc_outcome: Touch is efficient and nearly undetectable; at range it is lossy and visible

case: A slow-magic pack
reason: a slow pack makes bolts dodgeable with a recoil
doc_outcome: Bolts can be seen and dodged; a big one knocks its caster over

case: An active scan of a house where people hide
reason: active scanning finds people and reveals the scanner
doc_outcome: Finds them, and reveals the scanner to any sensitive among them

case: A careful mage crosses a guarded estate
reason: passive sensing stays hidden
doc_outcome: Senses only passively and stays hidden

case: Investigators at a crime scene weeks later
reason: a spell leaves a faint trace in iron, a lasting imprint of a weak kind
doc_outcome: Read the faint trace a spell wrote into an iron gate

case: A mage casts quietly to stay hidden
reason: quiet casting has a short range
doc_outcome: Reaches only a few metres

case: A fugitive mage beside a ley line
reason: background field hides tells
doc_outcome: The background drowns out their tells

case: A spell on an iron lock in a wooden door
reason: steered redox chemistry rusts the iron
doc_outcome: Rusts the lock through by driving the iron-oxygen reaction; the wood is untouched

case: A strong pulse near copper wiring
reason: induced currents spark wiring
doc_outcome: The wiring sparks

case: A compass beside a powerful casting
reason: a field changes a magnetised needle
doc_outcome: The needle twitches

case: A mage makes light
reason: field to light through the mixing portal at limited efficiency
doc_outcome: Light without heat, at a limited efficiency

case: Sensitives near a lightning strike
reason: a lightning strike disturbs the field and sensitives feel it
doc_outcome: Feel a brief surge in the field

case: Turning lead into gold
reason: transmutation is lawful at nuclear cost with a large store; radioactive product
doc_outcome: Lawful; needs an enormous store; the product is dangerously radioactive

case: A swindler's magical "gold"
reason: a gilded alloy exposed by a density test
doc_outcome: A gilded alloy, exposed by a density test

case: Conjuring water from the air in a desert
reason: condensing humidity, limited by the air
doc_outcome: Slow, limited by the humidity

case: An exact copy of a person, and a rough copy of a pure crystal
reason: an exact copy of a person is impossible; a rough crystal copy is T1
doc_outcome: The first is impossible (information); the second is easy

case: An old alchemist who once truly transmuted metal
reason: transmutation fallout produces radiation sickness
doc_outcome: Died of a wasting sickness nobody understood

case: Making a frightened horse obey a command
reason: entrainment calms but a command would write a belief
doc_outcome: Calming works; the command does not

case: The same entrainment on a trained, focused mind and an untrained one
reason: a focused mind resists entrainment
doc_outcome: The focused mind resists; the untrained one is overwhelmed

case: Calming a willing patient and an unwilling one
reason: consent lowers the energy cost
doc_outcome: The willing one costs a fraction of the energy

case: A caster makes a flash appear in someone's vision
reason: an induced percept; the target decides what it was
doc_outcome: The target sees it and decides for themselves what it was

case: A mage who always induces calm when present
reason: conditioning is ordinary psychology
doc_outcome: Comes to be liked by conditioning, and loses it when found out

case: A cap of conducting material
reason: conductive matter blocks the field
doc_outcome: Blocks mind magic

case: Planting a false memory in a stranger
reason: writing a false memory writes beliefs, which the field never does
doc_outcome: Out of reach

case: An intuitive healer speeds a small cut
reason: guided regeneration without a template leaves a scar
doc_outcome: It heals faster and still scars

case: A skilled healer closes a deep cut using the skin around it as the template
reason: neighbouring skin is a template for scarless repair
doc_outcome: Heals without a scar

case: Regrowing a lost finger
reason: regrowth needs food, time and a template
doc_outcome: Weeks, plenty of food, and the matching finger as the template

case: A healer speeds a badly set break
reason: faster healing sets a bad fracture faster
doc_outcome: It heals crooked, faster

case: Forcing growth without a good pattern
reason: growth without a pattern is a disordered lump
doc_outcome: A disordered, tumour-like lump

case: A starving patient, healed by magic
reason: healing needs food energy
doc_outcome: Barely heals

case: Raising the dead
reason: raising the dead is not a state ordinary physics reaches
doc_outcome: Impossible unless a pack adds it

case: A mage channels too much power through their own body
reason: channelled power heats the body, a physiological limit
doc_outcome: Collapses with heatstroke

case: Keeping a forge hot by magic
reason: holding heat costs the full loss rate
doc_outcome: Costs its full heat loss, continuously

case: A weak mage uses a carved battery-and-trigger device
reason: a stored store releases power the body could not
doc_outcome: Releases far more power than their body could handle

case: Two resonators set to feed each other
reason: mutual feedback grows until the local field drains
doc_outcome: Grow until they drain the local field, then stop
